{{Short description|Overview of Albanian NUTS statistical regions}}

{{Administration in Albania}}

The [[Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics]] (NUTS) is a geographical standard used by [[Albania]] in order to divide its territory into regions at three different levels of specified classes of its population codified by the [[Institute of Statistics (Albania)|Albanian Institute of Statistics]] (INSTAT). Albania is a recognised [[Potential enlargement of the European Union|candidate country]] for membership of the [[European Union]] (EU) and thus part of the classification.<ref>{{cite web |publisher=[[Eurostat]] |title=NUTS–Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics: NUTS Maps |url=https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/nuts/nuts-maps |access-date=14 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211014215100/https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/nuts/nuts-maps |archive-date=14 October 2021 |url-status=live}}</ref> The three hierarchical levels are known as NUTS-1, NUTS-2 and NUTS-3, moving from larger to smaller territorial divisions.<ref>{{cite web |publisher=[[Eurostat]] |title=NUTS–Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics:Principles and Characteristics |url=https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/nuts/principles-and-characteristics |access-date=14 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211014215556/https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/nuts/principles-and-characteristics |archive-date=14 October 2021 |url-status=live}}</ref>
